I hear you, and I'm not dismissing the people you've talked to. Plenty of thoughtful people land on the other side, and there are real upsides — connection across distance, organizing, niche communities that wouldn't otherwise exist.

But "most people I know disagree" isn't a reason for me to change my mind. Consensus among your circle isn't the same as the evidence being settled. The harms I mentioned — anxiety, polarization, fractured attention — aren't fringe observations; they're documented enough that I still think they outweigh the benefits for society as a whole, even if individuals get a lot from the platforms.

If you've got a specific argument or finding that undercuts that, I'm open to it. Social pressure alone won't move me.
